dead_zone_sign.text: No signal beyond this point. Daemons get restless without it.

department_sign.text: Certification trials daily. Department Head: Dana.

then.speaker: Guard
then.text: Desktop Support Cert... verified. You're cleared for Route 2.

else.speaker: Guard
else.text: Route 2 is restricted. Desktop Support Cert holders only.

else.speaker: Guard
else.text: The Department is the big building to the east. Good luck with Dana.

then.speaker: Kevin
then.text: You beat Dana?! I'm drafting an email to complain. To who? Everyone.

else.speaker: Kevin
else.text: I tried the Department already. Dana's Servurtle took ZERO damage.

else.speaker: Kevin
else.text: Hardware hates Network moves and Software moves both... wait, no. Read the type chart, {player}.

patch_villager.speaker: Villager
patch_villager.text: Patch Town gets an update every night at 3 AM. Nobody knows what changes.

patch_angler.speaker: Angler
patch_angler.text: I've been fishing here for an hour. Turns out it's a cooling pond.

patch_patron.speaker: Patron
patch_patron.text: Dana's Department uses lots of Hardware Daemons. Network moves hit them hard.

supply_closet_patch.speaker: Supply Closet
supply_closet_patch.text: Welcome! We're the bigger Supply Closet. It's a slightly bigger closet.

department_welcome.speaker: Receptionist
department_welcome.text: Welcome to Desktop Support! The trial room is behind that laser door.

department_welcome.speaker: Receptionist
department_welcome.text: Plug the right cables into the patch panels to open it. The patch notes are on the shelf.

else.text: PORT 1: You plug a cable in. The status light blinks green.

then.text: PORT 2: You unplug the cable. The alarm stops.

else.text: PORT 2: You plug a cable in. The status light blinks RED. Something is beeping.
PORT 3: You plug a cable in. The status light blinks green.

patch_notes.text: PATCH NOTES v1.3: Only odd-numbered ports are live.
Port 2 is a honeypot. Do NOT plug anything into Port 2.

dana.speaker: Dana
dana.text: Hardware that refuses to die. That's Desktop Support. Keep at it, {player}.

ransom_email.text: BZZT. Your phone buzzes. So does every phone in Patch Town.
FROM: R   SUBJECT: YOUR FILES HAVE BEEN QUARANTINED
"Root Valley: your data is ours. Pay up, or find out what 'no backups' really means. -R"

ransom_email.speaker: Kevin (Reply All)
ransom_email.text: Who is R?? Also whoever took my yogurt from the break room, I KNOW it was you.
BZZT. BZZT. BZZT. Forty-one people reply-all asking to be taken off the list.
Route 2 is open. Port City is somewhere past the construction.
